# HR Technology & Product Trends

| Trend | Industry direction |
| --- | --- |
| Workflow-native AI | AI is moving from job-description drafting and summaries into recruitment, onboarding, attendance and payroll workflows. |
| Attendance-to-payroll closure | The strongest operational value comes from linking attendance, exceptions, overtime, payroll, tax and social-insurance data. |
| Industry templates | Manufacturing, retail, logistics and hospitality need reusable rules for shifts, locations, staffing peaks and wage components. |
| Trust and governance | Bias testing, human review, explanation, access control and audit trails increasingly shape procurement. |
| Cross-border HCM | Regional payroll rules, data residency, language, currency and time-zone support are becoming differentiators. |
| Competitive implication | Workday, SAP SuccessFactors and regional HCM vendors are adding AI; a durable position requires workflow depth, local rules, integration and delivery evidence. |
